sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
Our order history for this part shows 28.94 EUR (po:4500010017-10) against 29.89 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014436-10).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is 24.31 EUR (cost:340010).
We can work with your lead time of 56 days.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We acknowledge your proposed volume increase to 23,400 units over 24 months and adjust our price to €31.50 per unit. Our offer stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

This offer reflects the maximum flexibility available under our current capacity constraints. As a matter of corporate policy, we do not provide internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your revised offer and the alternative of a 36-month contract term. Management has reviewed your request and authorized an adjustment to €31.20 per unit for this extended commitment. This rate reflects the maximum concession available for the specified volume and duration.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our primary offer comprises a price of €31.20 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €31.20 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, and a volume of 23400 pcs per year.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to?

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (3)
move.body:
Thank you for your final offer. We are close to placing the order. Before we sign, could you check once more with your management whether this is truly the best price you can give us on these terms, for a firm order today?

Best regards
